title: Start a task
text:
The goal is [the outcome for the user].
Current evidence is in [reproduction steps, files and logs].
The constraints are [contracts, compatibility and change scope].
Investigate to [the required depth] and inspect the existing structure first.
Completion means [behavior that can actually be observed].
Follow through within the authorized scope of changes and execution.
Report the results, verification evidence and remaining uncertainty separately.

title: Map a feature
text:
Describe [feature] in the order a real user would use it.
Connect entry point → prerequisites → actions → expected results → data to inspect.
Separate observations in the app from inferences based only on source code.
Flag missing conditions and stale explanations.
Follow this repository's permissions for creating and running tests.

title: Address recurring mistakes
text:
Find why [recurring error] keeps happening.
Before adding instructions, check whether example code, APIs
or data structures encourage the wrong behavior.
Suggest a small preventive change to structure, types, lint rules or permitted checks.
Explain which cases it prevents and which it does not.

title: Review state and concurrency
text:
Describe the user's intent and the invariants for [state transition or race].
Show states, events and transitions in a diagram.
State what the model includes and which environment conditions it excludes.
Use permitted checks and verify the correspondence between code and model.
Explain counterexamples as sequences of user actions.
Do not claim guarantees beyond the explored scope.

title: Ask another model to review
text:
The original requirements are [requirements], and the target revision is [commit].
Focus the review on [important failure types].
Independently compare the original requirements, actual diff and execution results.
For each finding, give its location, triggering conditions, impact and a way to verify it.
Separate preferences and speculation from actual defects.
Do not make changes. Report only findings worth fixing.

title: Hand off long-running work
text:
Summarize the current state so the next session can continue.
Separate the goal, settled decisions, remaining assumptions, current revision,
completed changes, actual execution evidence, failed attempts,
remaining work and next action.
List anything that must be checked again if the execution environment changes.
Do not include sensitive values or unnecessary raw logs.

title: Improve performance
text:
The target metric is [latency, memory, cost, etc.].
Keep the comparison inputs, environment, versions and measurement interval fixed.
Preserve [conditions] for correctness and compatibility.
Do not change the evaluation criteria to make the result look better.
Report before-and-after values, measurement limits and any new costs.
If there is no progress within [time and cost budget], summarize the cause.

title: Learn from the result
text:
Explain the main cause behind this change so I can understand it.
Use a small example to connect input → state change → result.
Distinguish real cases from hypothetical examples.
Give me 3 questions I should try to explain myself
and 2 assumptions that are easy to get wrong.
After I give my explanation, use the code and execution evidence to give feedback.
